name: Bushcraft Knife
summary: The Bushcraft Knife is one of the knives in the game's Melee Weapon class.
body: Game8's work-in-progress melee list, updated on launch eve, shows three entries so far: Bushcraft Knife, Diving Knife and Hunting Knife.
Game8 gives no stats, brand, price or location for it yet.
PowerPyx reports that the Progress database counts 9 melee weapons in total, so six are still unnamed in the pages read.

name: Frag Grenade
summary: The Frag Grenade is a thrown explosive listed in the game's Explosive class.
body: Game8's work-in-progress explosives list shows two entries so far: Frag Grenade and Sticky Bomb, without stats or prices.
PowerPyx's cheat list says the All Explosive Weapons cheat is unlocked by throwing 100 grenades.
PowerPyx reports the Progress database counts 4 explosives; no page read lists all four by name.

name: Molotov
summary: The Molotov is a thrown fire bottle that the player can carry and use to burn vehicles and rooms.
body: PowerPyx says a molotov thrown through the doorway is one way to burn a Kitty Litter lab, and that the Exploding Bottles cheat is unlocked by throwing 100 molotovs.
IGN and Eurogamer both recorded, before launch, that Lucia uses a Molotov to burn a getaway car in Rockstar's Extended Look.
No page read confirms whether the Progress database files it under Explosives or what its exact in-game name is.

name: Flash Grenades
summary: Flash Grenades are stun throwables left for the player in a car trunk during the mission Car Service.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough says the contact leaves Flash Grenades and a silenced Klose K17 in a nearby trunk, and that using them is optional.
PowerPyx's Cartel Heist walkthrough also describes a SWAT team using a flashbang on the player.
No page read confirms whether Flash Grenades are one of the 4 database Explosives.

facts.availability: Car trunk during Car Service (Steal The Car for Raul)

name: Arras Bullhead
summary: The Arras Bullhead is a harpoon used underwater, equipped from the left side of the weapon wheel.
body: PowerPyx's Island Dreams walkthrough tells the player to equip the Arras Bullhead harpoon before a shark appears, and says two harpoon hits drive the shark off.
No page read gives its stats, price or whether it counts among the 53 database guns.

facts.availability: Used in Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)

name: Donnie's H&L .38
summary: Donnie's H&L .38 is a missable unique revolver variant found in the trunk of Donnie's car.
body: PowerPyx says it must be taken from the trunk during Don Gone before the car is destroyed, otherwise it is missed.

facts.availability: Trunk of Donnie's car in Don Gone (Jason, after Chapter 1 Swamped); missable

name: Gil's Kalinga .50
summary: Gil's Kalinga .50 is a pistol variant given for opening the practice safe at the end of Safe Word.
body: PowerPyx says the player receives it, plus $1,500 from the safe, on finishing the optional safecracking practice at Raul's compound.

facts.availability: Reward for completing the safecracking practice in Safe Word (Chapter 3)

name: Bae-Luxe's Bat
summary: Bae-Luxe's Bat is a melee variant weapon given as the reward for the mission Cooties.
body: PowerPyx lists it as the mission reward and says the Dimez hand Lucia a bat to hit DWNPLY's car during the video shoot.
No page read names the standard bat it is a variant of.

facts.availability: Reward for Cooties (Shoot the Music Video), after Chapter 3 Ride or Die

name: Mister Mangrove Laird 350
summary: The Mister Mangrove Laird 350 is a tranquilizer-rifle variant of the Laird 350 handed over by Kirk.
body: PowerPyx says Kirk gives it to Lucia in his helicopter at the start of Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove, a night-only side mission for Lucia.

facts.availability: Given by Kirk in Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (Lucia only, night only)

name: Unique weapon variants
summary: The Progress database tracks 130 unique weapon variants, found in stores, gang operations and missions.
body: PowerPyx says each of the 24 Ammu-Nation stores sells at least one unique variant, sometimes several, and that variants are not needed for 100% completion.
PowerPyx says illegal gang operations usually hold a unique variant among their key valuables.
No page read lists all 130 by name.
